target.title: feat(reply): annotate recent history images
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #48321.

Recent inbound history images were attached to ACP reply turns with sender and optional message id only. The model could see an old screenshot without knowing when it was sent or where it appeared in the available thread history, which makes stale visual context harder to reason about.

## Why This Change Was Made

`resolveRecentInboundHistoryImages` already walks structured `InboundHistory` entries that carry timestamps and stable order. This change preserves that existing data on each resolved recent history image and includes it in the shared prompt-side note generated by `appendRecentHistoryImageContext`.

The fix stays in the shared history-media path so Slack, Discord, Telegram, and other ACP-backed channel history flows get the same metadata without channel-specific behavior or a new config surface. The prompt note still omits local media paths.

## User Impact

When a recent history image is re-attached to an ACP turn, the agent now receives metadata like sent time and `thread message N of M`. That gives the model enough context to treat older screenshots as historical when later text says the state changed, while preserving the image attachment for valid compare/debug workflows.

## Evidence

CI at head `159556f863af0816aaa81dd57150190c8753fa26` is green, including the repository `Real behavior proof` check:

- `gh pr checks 100866 --repo openclaw/openclaw`
- `Real behavior proof` passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28790498289/job/85367623014
- Note: that workflow validates external PR evidence shape; the runtime proof below is the behavior evidence for this PR.

Crabbox/Testbox proof was attempted first, but the local wrapper is unavailable in this checkout:

```bash
command -v crabbox
# exit 1
../crabbox/bin/crabbox --version
# zsh: no such file or directory: ../crabbox/bin/crabbox
node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs run --help
# [crabbox] bin=crabbox version=unknown provider=blacksmith-testbox providers=unknown
# [crabbox] selected binary failed basic --version/--help sanity checks
```

Closest available redacted runtime proof, run against a temporary checkout of PR head `159556f863af0816aaa81dd57150190c8753fa26`:

```bash
git archive origin/pr/100866 | tar -x -C "$tmpdir"
ln -s /Users/martinlos/code/openclaw/node_modules "$tmpdir/node_modules"
cd "$tmpdir"
node --import tsx --input-type=module
```

The proof script used the production `resolveAgentTurnAttachments` and `appendRecentHistoryImageContext` path with a real temporary local PNG file under an allowed attachment root, a redacted Discord-style threaded `InboundHistory`, and an ACP turn prompt. It asserted the history image was re-attached, the prompt contained sent-time and thread-position metadata, and the local media path/root did not appear in the agent-facing prompt.

Redacted output:

```text

local_path_exposed=no
agent_prompt_redacted_begin
The page is fixed now; compare with prior screenshot only if needed.

[Recent image 1 from @redacted-reporter, message redacted-msg-2, sent at 2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z, thread message 2 of 3, attached as media.]
agent_prompt_redacted_end
```

Focused local fallback proof retained from the original PR validation:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-acp.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/history.test.ts
```

Result: 2 Vitest shards passed; 57 tests passed.

Static checks:

```bash
node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/auto-reply/reply/history-media.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-acp.test.ts
node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/auto-reply/reply/history-media.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-acp.test.ts
git diff --check
```

Autoreview:

```bash
.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview
```

Result: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.

Not run: live Slack/Discord/Telegram credentialed channel reproduction, because this environment does not have live channel credentials and Crabbox/Testbox is unavailable as shown above. The redacted runtime proof exercises the shared ACP history image prompt path used by channel-backed ACP turns and verifies that private local media paths are not exposed.
